name: Wearable Robotics & Exoskeletons
summary: Robots worn on the body, including powered exoskeletons, soft exosuits and prostheses, that augment or restore human strength and mobility.

topics.name: Taxonomy: upper- and lower-limb, full-body, rigid exoskeletons and soft exosuits
Human biomechanics and gait analysis for wearable design
Actuation for wearables: series-elastic, cable-driven, quasi-direct-drive, hydraulic
Power and energy: batteries, efficiency and metabolic cost
Detecting user intent: EMG, EEG/brain-computer interfaces, force and IMU sensing
Control strategies: assist-as-needed, impedance/admittance and torque control
Powered prostheses: ankle, knee and hand
Industrial and military exoskeletons for load carrying and strength augmentation
Human-machine interfaces and feedback (haptics, heads-up displays)
